_comment: Declared, justified differences between the SQLite schema built by
SQLiteStore._setup() and the Postgres schema built by migrations/*.sql.
Anything not declared here fails scripts/check_storage_schema_parity.py.
R112 added this file because document_version.filing_date drifted for 27
rounds: it existed only in SQLite, and the Postgres read path hid the gap

table_map_reasons.evaluations: Same logical table under two historical names. Renaming either side rewrites a shipped schema for cosmetics; the mapping is declared instead.

postgres_only_tables.research_session: Declared in 001 and never referenced by any code path. Dead schema, kept because dropping it is a destructive migration against deployed databases.
postgres_only_tables.index_job: Declared in 001 and never referenced by any code path. Dead schema, see research_session.
postgres_only_tables.retrieval_trace: Declared in 001 and never referenced by any code path. Dead schema, see research_session.

evidence.reason: SQLite preserves evidence insertion order through its implicit rowid, which list_evidence orders by. Postgres has no such column, so the same ordering guarantee needs an explicit position.
